title: Unpredictable range slider behaviour on mobile devices
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Report a bug.

**Bug: What is the current behaviour?**
The upper bound handle of the range slider widget is unpredictable and/or intermittently unresponsive on mobile devices. The lower bound handle appears to be unaffected.

Example available via [this fiddle](https://jsfiddle.net/gsenior/bLjtmzku/1/).

Also, when utilising multiple range sliders, the upper bound handle of slider A can occasionally be moved by the lower bound handle of slider B.

![slider-issue](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/768967/29617623-5c2cda32-880d-11e7-9628-ec830183179d.gif)

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**
We have reproduced the issue on the following:

- Chrome v60 on Android 7.1.2
- Safari on iOS 10.3.3 
- Chrome v60 on iOS 10.3.3

It can also be replicated on desktop Chrome (v60) by using the Developer Tools -> Device Toolbar -> (e.g. Nexus 5X).

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**
After a bit of hunting around, I _think_ this is related to Preact, Rheostat and event handling. I've created my own build of instantsearch.js, swapping out Preact for React and the issue is resolved. 

I wonder if it is related this bug - https://github.com/iam4x/preact-key0-repro-bug?
